name: app_smoke
description: Build and smoke-test the original application, unchanged. Load for the smoke stage of a run pipeline, when the smoke run wrote its data outside the session (data_dir), or for a flux batch smoke job.

history.why: Job smoke-933998287 (pipeline elmerfold-prov-20261030-125944) exited rc 2 at 'uv venv --relocatable /p/lustre5/haridev/elmerfold/openfoldenv' (failed to create file .../lib/python3.13/site-packages/_virtualenv.py: No such file or directory, flux-job: task(s) exited with exit code 2) on tuolumne1009, yet the summary said 'smoke passed, wrote 0 file(s)'. Fix: the summary and smoke_validate fail on any non-zero rc (shared helper smoke_rc_verdict); smoke_run gets explicit build_where (compute default; login only with a quoted user approval, recorded in the job log header; login build is a background job and the smoke run stays on compute). Lessons L-b62f45b4, L-d4e3d3ef.

Job smoke-934167821 (pipeline elmerfold-prov-20261030-125944, flux batch f3hERTfUyEVd, rc 0, 457.4 s) wrote 10 tars to /p/lustre5/haridev/elmerfold/runs/smoke/output/chunk_000000, outside the session; smoke_validate said inconclusive 'ask the user where its data goes' and the user answered with the dir, but neither smoke_run nor smoke_validate could take it, so pipeline_advance stayed blocked. Fix: optional data_dir on smoke_run (recorded) and smoke_validate (argument, else the recorded one) inventoried into outputs_created/summary and judged as the outputs check; pure helpers smoke_data_inventory and smoke_data_verdict carry the checks; rc check kept, batch rc noted.
